selected_candidate.hypothesis: A bounded macro/event/text-state information family may add incremental value over the current matched ridge and recovered-HGB baselines when evaluated on the same chronological target/support; this must be tested as a material input/cohort change, not by relabeling older directional or rich-family work.
selected_candidate.why_this_candidate: Design 27.4 names event-existence, numeric-surprise, text-state/change, observed-reaction and combined variants as parallel information-value questions; the distinct-method check found no third exact-provenance model mechanism, so the next supported uncertainty is feature population rather than another model label.

differs_from_completed: Not the completed residual layer, curve-shape layer, rich-feature/dependence packets, ridge baseline, or recovered-HGB baseline.
Freezes a future material feature/cohort question: macro/event/text-state incremental information on matched chronological targets.
Treats retained directional bundles only as prior evidence about feature families and cost-aware interpretation, not as an accepted current comparison.

source_artifacts.role: reuse census and saved-model identity source
prior directional-feature evidence and non-qualification proof

baseline_controls: matched ridge baseline from current matched chronological development lineage
recovered HGB baseline from current matched chronological development lineage
no-change/simple historical baseline when target/support reconstruction provides native comparable rows
target_support_gate: Before fit or replay, identify the exact target rows, horizons and mature-label cutoff shared with ridge/HGB controls.
Report matched coverage and native coverage separately; no inherited historical result may be copied as a current score.
If macro/event/text-state features cannot be joined to the same keys without leakage or missing-source ambiguity, record unavailable support and do not compute.
chronology_gate: All feature publication/source clocks must be <= decision clock, and all labels must mature before their assessment partition.
Training, calibration and assessment partitions must be frozen before inspecting result metrics.
Any source-response cohort/version change creates a new cohort id and cannot be spliced into older track records.
leakage_checks: Future-perturbation or timestamp-shift control for macro/event/text fields must fail closed before scoring.
Hash every input frame and contract source before compute; verify hashes again at publication.
Refuse candidate if source availability depends on paid/live/API retrieval outside current authorization.

resource_bounds.fit_launch_requirement: A separate preflight must turn fit_allowed true only after source artifacts, matched keys and resource estimate are verified; this contract alone does not authorize fitting.

completion_gate: Vault packet publishes contract, validation receipt, design extract, source hashes and queue/checkpoint update.
Next compute card, if any, names exact input frames, controls, horizons, leakage tests, resource budget and stop criteria before running.
If no exact source support exists, the next run records blocker and continues to another independent design gap.
next_compute_preconditions: Operational preflight source/revision findings are reconciled or scoped to read-only preserved artifacts.
Macro/event/text-state input frames are located in current local/Vault artifacts and hashed.
Matched ridge/HGB predictions or controls are identified with exact keys for the same target/horizon set.
